fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) declined 8.2% as of 2:15 p.m. local time on November 13, with AI hardware selling pressure triggered by Nvidia CEO resignation spreading to memory and storage stocks.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal Q1 revenue of $11.0 billion (+378% year-over-year) and non-GAAP gross margin of 85.1% reflected supply shortage conditions, though risks of margin compression from supply gluts or AI demand softening exist.
fields.summary_ko.2: The Motley Fool Stock Advisor analysis team removed SanDisk from its list of 10 recommended stocks, advising investment caution given potential memory demand reduction from technological innovation.
